draft.title: Writing under exam conditions
card: Spend the first few minutes planning. Jot down your thesis, the order of your points and the evidence for each one before you write the first sentence.
Keep one clear thesis in view. Each paragraph should link back to it, so the essay stays on the question and does not drift.
Treat time as part of the task. Aim to finish with a few minutes left to write a conclusion, so the essay ends by returning to your argument.
A focused argument earns more than covering everything. Three well-analysed points usually serve you better than six that are only mentioned.
draft.remember: Plan briefly, stay on your thesis, save time to conclude, and go deep rather than wide.

a.q: Why is it sensible to spend a few minutes planning at the start of an exam essay?
opts: It sets your thesis and the order of your points
It lets you use more evidence than the question needs
It means you can skip writing a conclusion later
It lets you write down every idea you know about the text
a.why: A short plan fixes your thesis and the order of your points, so the essay stays focused. Writing down every idea is the tempting mistake, because the aim is to choose the points that best serve your argument.
a.clue: Think about what a plan gives the essay before you start writing.

b.q: Mia is writing a 40-minute essay on a set text. After 30 minutes she has made two strong points and has ideas for three more. What should she do?
opts: Write a conclusion that returns to her thesis
Squeeze in all three extra points in brief form
Skip the conclusion and add one more full paragraph
Start a new thesis that fits all five points
b.why: A conclusion that returns to her thesis ends a focused argument, and she has time to write it. Squeezing in all three extra points is tempting, but covering everything earns less than a focused argument that is developed well.
b.clue: Ask what gives the essay a clear ending without losing focus.

a.best: It sets your thesis and the order of your points

b.best: Write a conclusion that returns to her thesis
